metadata.title: Noir Portrait with Venetian Blind Shadows

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white portrait featuring dramatic geometric shadows from window blinds cast across a dark background.
excludeWhen: soft diffused lighting without shadows is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered monochrome portrait of a man in a dark shirt, positioned against a wall where the left side is dominated by sharp, horizontal light-and-shadow stripes from a window blind, while the right side features a soft, vignetted glow.
coreVisualRelationships: Geometric shadow patterns contrasting with organic facial features
Deep black foreground merging into a textured grey background
Top-aligned horizontal text balancing the verticality of the subject
coreInvariants: Strict black and white color palette
Horizontal blind shadow motif on the left third
Subject's torso fading into total blackness at the bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-close up portrait, centered horizontally, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the sharp contrast of the blind shadows.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the high-contrast shadows on the left, move to the subject's face, then up to the header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of deep blacks in the lower half and soft grey gradients on the right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for shadows and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the typography and highlights in the shadow pattern.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone greys for skin texture and background gradients.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between light stripes and dark voids.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both name and title, separated by a middle dot.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment along the top edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 'M' and 'O' shapes and uniform weight.
Captures the 70s/80s geometric aesthetic and wide tracking potential.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black and white portrait of a man in a black button-down shirt. The lighting should feature sharp horizontal venetian blind shadows on the left wall and a soft light fall-off on the right wall. The bottom of the image should fade into solid black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of white geometric sans-serif text in all caps at the very top. Use wide tracking and a middle dot to separate the two halves of the text.

verificationChecks: Are the blind shadows sharp and horizontal?
Is the text centered at the top with wide spacing?
Does the subject's clothing blend into the dark bottom background?

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean separation between the white text and the dark background.
Ensure the shadow lines are parallel and consistent.
Verify the subject's gaze is directed forward.
Confirm the absence of any color tint (pure grayscale).
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Venetian Blind Shadow Pattern + Top-Aligned Geometric Sans-Serif Typography
